title: Opportunity
description: A discovered market opportunity surfaced by the Research / Discovery agents in the AI Venture Factory. One Opportunity represents a single problem-market pairing that has not yet been promoted to an Experiment.

id.description: Crockford-base32 ULID (26 chars). Generated by the Research agent at creation time.

discovered_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp WITH timezone offset (e.g., 2026-05-31T14:30:00+03:00 for IDT). UTC also acceptable.

url.description: Direct link to the observed signal. Required even for operator_intuition (use a placeholder URL pointing to operator's notes file).

snippet.description: Quoted excerpt or short summary of the signal. No PII; redact personal names/handles to first-initial only.

problem_statement.description: Plain-language statement of the problem this opportunity addresses. 30-500 chars enforces 'concrete but not yet a pitch'.

target_segment.description: Who has this problem. Role + industry + size where applicable.

geo.description: Primary geography. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, or 'GLOBAL', or 'IL' for Israel-specific.

signal_strength.description: 1 = single weak data point; 5 = multiple independent, recent, paid signals.

keywords.description: Searchable tags. Lowercase, kebab-case, 1-30 chars each.

notes.description: Free-form operator or agent notes. Empty string allowed.

related_opportunities.description: Other Opportunity IDs that overlap with this one (e.g., adjacent segments, duplicate-but-different-source).

score.description: Computed score breakdown. Dimension names must match keys in config/scoring_model.yaml.

per_dimension.description: Map of scoring dimension name -> numeric score. Keys must exist in config/scoring_model.yaml.

model_version.description: Version tag of the scoring model used.

status.description: Lifecycle stage of this opportunity. Promoted to an Experiment when status becomes 'building'.
